name: Customer Behavior Analytics
description: Transactional data cleaned in Power Query and modeled in DAX into KPI metrics with cross-filtering across segments, revenue, and subscriptions.

name: Weather & Air Quality Monitor
source: Live Weather and Air Quality Analytics Platform
description: Five-page operational report over a 4-layer S3 lake and 6 Athena views: catalog KPIs, weather trends, air-quality analysis down to PM2.5 and PM10, country-level city comparison, and a pipeline page tracking 64 API runs and 88 data-quality checks.

name: California Wildfire Analysis
description: County-level view of burned acreage and seasonality, backed by a 7-year ETL that enriches fire records with weather API features.

name: Amazon Prime Content Analytics
source: Amazon Prime Movies & TV Shows Analytics Dashboard
description: Explores Amazon Prime Video's catalog across 1920–2021: an area chart of titles added per release year split Movie versus TV Show, a donut showing the 80.8% / 19.2% type mix, bar charts by content rating and by genre, a world map of origin country, and KPI cards for 9,655 titles, 25 ratings, genres and directors.
views: Titles by release year (Movie vs TV)

name: Airport Operations KPIs
description: Operational view of flight delays, passenger throughput, and on-time performance across terminals, fed by Python ETL over MySQL and MongoDB.

name: Data Science Salaries Explorer
description: Seven linked views over global data-science compensation: salary by experience level and employment type, company-size and seniority mixes, a Mapbox map of average salary by country, a job-title salary table down to experience level, and the top 10 employee residences — all driven by location and job-title filters.
